keyExpressions.en: It is too polite for him.
keyExpressions.ja: 彼にしては丁寧すぎる
こんな単語を使うのは誰？

keyExpressions.en: He never writes a long sentence.
keyExpressions.ja: 彼は長い文を書かない

questions.en: What would you eat for your last meal?
questions.ja: 最後の食事に何を食べる？
hintEn: I would eat ... with rice.
My last meal is ... because it is warm.
I want to eat ... at home.

questions.en: What would you take home from a museum?
questions.ja: 美術館から何を持ち帰る？
hintEn: I would take the ... home.
The ... is small enough to carry.
I want the old ... on the wall.

questions.ja: 月曜の朝を良くするものは？
hintEn: Hot coffee makes Monday better.
I need a long shower first.
Monday is fine if I sleep well.

questions.en: What small superpower do you want?
questions.ja: どんなささやかな超能力が欲しい？
hintEn: I want to sleep for one minute.
I want to find my keys.
I want to stop the rain.

questions.en: What is a lie everyone tells at work?
questions.ja: 職場でみんなが言う嘘は？
hintEn: Everyone says I am almost done.
People say they read the email.
We all say the meeting was useful.

questions.en: What one thing do you take to an island?
questions.ja: 島にひとつだけ持っていくものは？
hintEn: I take a big knife with me.
I bring a book and read it again.
I want a pot to boil water.

questions.en: What will you never do again?
questions.ja: もう二度としないことは？
hintEn: I will never run in the rain.
I never eat that much again.
I will not sing in front of people.

questions.en: Where would you go with a time machine?
questions.ja: タイムマシンでどこへ行く？
hintEn: I go back to last Friday.
I want to see the old city.
I would visit my school again.

questions.en: What is the worst advice you have heard?
questions.ja: 聞いた中で一番ひどい助言は？
hintEn: Someone said just be yourself.
They told me to sleep less.
My friend said money is nothing.

questions.en: What rule would you set in your house?
questions.ja: 自分の家にどんな決まりを作る？
hintEn: No phones at the table.
Everyone cooks on Sunday.
We do not talk before coffee.

questions.en: What do you lose most often?
questions.ja: 一番よく失くすものは？
hintEn: I lose my pen every week.
I always lose one glove.
My keys are never in my bag.

questions.en: How do you spend a free Sunday?
questions.ja: 何もない日曜をどう過ごす？
hintEn: I walk in the park alone.
I sleep until noon and eat.
I clean my room and read.
